name: TinyZKP Integrations
summary: Integration surfaces for adding TinyZKP proof receipts to agents, backend APIs, SDK workflows, CLI scripts, browser verification, badges, and long-trace Compute.

default_guidance.agent_workflows: Use MCP first. Return an agent receipt envelope and receipt URL with high-value agent outputs. Use the agent-platform guide when proof receipts should become a native capability inside an agent runtime, IDE, workflow engine, or marketplace.
default_guidance.backend_workflows: Use REST, SDKs, or CLI. Keep API keys server-side and attach receipts to responses or checkpoints.
default_guidance.recipient_verification: Use the public verifier, hosted verification API, or compatible first-party WASM verifier path. Verification is free.
default_guidance.large_traces: Use Compute when trace size makes high-RAM prover infrastructure the bottleneck.
default_guidance.data_boundary: Do not put secrets, private customer data, or API keys into transparent receipt parameters.

surfaces.name: MCP server
surfaces.best_for: AI agents and agent runtimes that need native proof and verification tools.
surfaces.install: claude mcp add --transport http tinyzkp https://mcp.tinyzkp.com
surfaces.returns: Proof job IDs, proof receipts, summaries, verification results, and capabilities.

surfaces.name: Claude Code MCP guide
surfaces.best_for: Claude Code users who want proof tools inside agentic development workflows.
surfaces.install: claude mcp add --transport http tinyzkp https://mcp.tinyzkp.com
surfaces.returns: Claude Code-accessible TinyZKP tools for proof generation, receipt retrieval, and verification.

surfaces.name: Cursor MCP guide
surfaces.best_for: Cursor users adding proof receipts to agentic coding, backfill, migration, and review workflows.
surfaces.install: Add https://mcp.tinyzkp.com in Cursor's MCP server configuration with an Authorization header for proving.
surfaces.returns: Cursor-accessible TinyZKP tools and receipt URLs for state-changing agent work.

surfaces.name: OpenAI-powered agent workflow guide
surfaces.best_for: OpenAI-powered agent applications that need verifiable tool results and backend state-transition receipts.
surfaces.install: Use TinyZKP REST, SDKs, or MCP behind server-side tools that return structured agent results.
surfaces.returns: Agent tool results with receipt URLs, verifier URLs, and explicit proof boundaries.

surfaces.name: REST API
surfaces.best_for: Backend services, edge workers, SaaS workflows, and server-owned proof submission.
surfaces.returns: Proof jobs, receipts, verification results, templates, estimates, and capabilities.

surfaces.name: Python SDK
surfaces.best_for: Backend services, data pipelines, audit jobs, and operational scripts.
surfaces.returns: Typed API wrappers around the hosted proof and verification endpoints.

surfaces.name: TypeScript SDK
surfaces.best_for: Node.js apps, edge workers, developer tooling, and receipt-aware web services.
surfaces.returns: JavaScript integration helpers for proof submission, polling, and verification.

surfaces.name: CLI
surfaces.best_for: Smoke tests, local workflows, support reproduction, and CI checks.
surfaces.returns: Command-line proof generation, polling, and verification output.

surfaces.name: Browser verifier
surfaces.best_for: Customer, auditor, and recipient verification without source-system access.
surfaces.returns: Verification result for pasted receipts or compatible local WASM verification.

surfaces.name: Verified by TinyZKP badge
surfaces.best_for: Customer-facing pages, audit records, dashboards, and receipt links.
surfaces.returns: Embeddable badge asset linked to receipt verification.

surfaces.name: Compute
surfaces.best_for: Long supported state-transition traces, backfills, audit packages, and high-RAM prover alternatives.
surfaces.returns: Usage-based long-trace proof receipts priced by trace step.
